name: EXP-C1 · Day 1 · Staircase — ZONE-A
description: Full staircase 0-1-2-3-4-6-8-10 in ZONE-A, seated and walking at each level, 175 s per sub-block. Three zones give the geometry axis inside one hall, which lifts the design from six folds to nine.

config.description:
The operator changes the number of people between sub-blocks; that change is the measurement. Keep the phone in a pocket, screen off, and stay inside the marked zone — 341 m² of hall is sparse for whole-room sensing, and the result depends on the links crossing a bounded group.

The phone does not illuminate — it marks block boundaries and carries the truth channel. Illumination is monad01 injecting on 2.4 GHz ch11.
